title: Death Ball Test TpParry
script:
---==== 
---====
---====
---====
---====
local Vitrual = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

local CurrentCharacter = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = CurrentCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local PlayerRoot = CurrentCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local SavePositionPlayer = nil

Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	CurrentCharacter = character
end)

-- === States === --
local States = {
	Wait = "Wait",
	Target = "Target",
}
local CurrentState = States.Wait 
local function UpdateState(State)
	if not States[State] then
		warn("ERROR STATE:", State)
		return
	end
	CurrentState = State
end

-- == -- == -- == -- Follow Block -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == --
local FollowBlock = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
FollowBlock.Size = Vector3.new(8, 8, 8)
FollowBlock.Anchored = true
FollowBlock.CanCollide = false
FollowBlock.Transparency = 0
FollowBlock.Color = Color3.new(0.101961, 1, 0)


-- === Delete/AddBall Function === -- 
local function CreateBallBillboard(Part)
	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui", Part)
	billboard.Name = "BallBillboard"
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromScale(7, 4)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = false
	billboard.MaxDistance = 300
	billboard.Enabled = true
	billboard.Adornee = Part

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", billboard)
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	
	label.RichText = true
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Text = "Ball:" .. Part.Name

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", label)
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
	
end


local CurrentBall = nil
local FollowConnection = nil

local function NewGet(Part)
	if FollowConnection then
		FollowConnection:Disconnect()
		FollowConnection = nil
	end
	
	FollowConnection = Part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		if Part and Part.Parent and FollowBlock then
			FollowBlock.CFrame = Part.CFrame
		end
	end)
end

local function SearchBall(Part)
	if Part.Name ~= "Part" then
		return false
	end
	if Part.Parent ~= workspace then
		return false
	end
	
	if not Part:IsA("MeshPart") then
		return false
	end
	
	local Highlight = Part:FindFirstChild("Highlight")
	if not Highlight then
		return false
	end
	
	if Highlight.FillTransparency == 0.5 then
		return false
	end
	
	return true
end

for _, Part in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
	if SearchBall(Part) then
		CurrentBall = Part
		CurrentBallPosition = Part.Position
		CreateBallBillboard(Part)
		NewGet(Part)
		print("Ball: " .. Part.Name)
		break
	end
end

workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Part)
	if SearchBall(Part) then
		CurrentBall = Part
		CurrentBallPosition = Part.Position
		CreateBallBillboard(Part)
		NewGet(Part)
		print("Ball: " .. Part.Name)
		
	end
end)

workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(Part)
	if Part == CurrentBall then
		CurrentBall = nil
		CurrentBallPosition = nil
		
		if FollowConnection then
			FollowConnection:Disconnect()
			FollowConnection = nil
		end
		print("Ball.Deleted: " .. Part.Name)
	end
end)

-- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- == -- ==
local function DeletekillBlock(Part)
	 local FX = workspace:FindFirstChild("FX")
	 if not FX then
		 return false
	 end

	if Part.Parent ~= FX then
		return false
	end
	 
	if not Part:IsA("Part") then        
		return false
	end
	 
	 if Part.Name ~= "Part" then
		return false
	 end
	 
	 if Part.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon then
		return false
	 end
	 
	 if Part.Color ~= Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) then
		 return false
	 end
	 
	 if Part.CastShadow ~= true then
		return false
	 end
	 
	 return true
end

local FX = workspace:FindFirstChild("FX")
if FX then
for _, Part in pairs(workspace.FX:GetChildren()) do
	if DeletekillBlock(Part) then
		task.defer(function()
			Part:Destroy()
			print("Kill.Part:" .. Part.Name  ..":Destroy()")
		end)
	end
end

workspace.FX.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Part)
	if DeletekillBlock(Part) then
		task.defer(function()
			  Part:Destroy()
			  print("Kill.Part:" .. Part.Name  ..":Destroy()")
		   end)
	    end
    end)
end

-- === Parry Function and t/d === -- 
local function parry()
	Vitrual:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.F, false, game)
	Vitrual:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.F, false, game)
end

local function IsTarget()
	local Highlight = CurrentCharacter:FindFirstChild("Highlight", true)
	if not Highlight then
		return false
	end
	
	if Highlight.FillTransparency == 1 then
		return false
	end
	
    return true
end

local function IsParry()
	local Highlight = CurrentCharacter:FindFirstChild("Highlight", true)
	if not Highlight then
		return false
	end
	
	if Highlight.OutlineTransparency == 1 then
		return false
	end
	
	return true
end


RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
	
	if IsTarget() then
		UpdateState(States.Target)
	end
	
	if not IsTarget() then
		UpdateState(States.Wait)
	end
end)

local function Update()
	if CurrentState == States.Wait then
	   print("awawa")
	end
	
	if CurrentState == States.Target then
		parry()
		task.defer(function()
				PlayerRoot.Position = CurrentBall.Position
		end)
	end
end

RunService.PreRender:Connect(Update)
